steps.name: Apply reviewed XSign source
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
python3 -u - <<'XSIGN_SOURCE_UPDATE'
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import lzma
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath

def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if path.is_file() else None

def local_path(name):
    relative = PurePosixPath(name)
    if relative.is_absolute() or str(relative) != name or ".." in relative.parts or not relative.parts:
        raise SystemExit(f"Invalid reviewed path: {name}")
    path = Path(name)
    if any(part.is_symlink() for part in (path, *path.parents)):
        raise SystemExit(f"Symlink blocks source verification: {name}")
    if path.exists() and not path.is_file():
        raise SystemExit(f"Invalid reviewed source: {name}")
    return path

helper = local_path('XSign_Reviewed_Update.py')
current_helper = '__REVIEWED_SHA256__'
workflow_file = Path('.github/workflows/XSign_Full_Link.yml')
lines = workflow_file.read_text().splitlines()
marker = '# xsign-source: '
embedded = ''.join(line.removeprefix(marker) for line in lines if line.startswith(marker))
if not embedded:
    if digest(helper) != current_helper:
        raise SystemExit('Add the matching XSign_Reviewed_Update.py at the repository root.')
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-u', str(helper)], check=True)
    sys.exit(0)

payload = json.loads(lzma.decompress(base64.b64decode(embedded, validate=True), memlimit=64*1024*1024))
basis = payload['basis']
updates = payload['updates']

def pending_changes():
    changes = []
    for name, accepted_versions, after in updates:
        path = local_path(name)
        current = digest(path)
        data = after.encode('utf-8')
        if current == hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest():
            continue
        if current not in accepted_versions:
            raise SystemExit(f'Reviewed source differs: {name}. Use the matching companion for an older checkout.')
        changes.append((path, data))
    return changes

helper_hash = digest(helper)
if helper_hash == current_helper:
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-u', str(helper)], check=True)
elif any(digest(local_path(name)) != expected for name, expected in basis):
    if helper_hash not in payload['previous_helpers']:
        raise SystemExit('This checkout requires the matching XSign_Reviewed_Update.py at the repository root.')
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-u', str(helper)], check=True)

changes = pending_changes()
for path, data in changes:
    path.write_bytes(data)
print(f'Applied {len(changes)} embedded source updates.')
XSIGN_SOURCE_UPDATE

steps.name: Publish X-SIGN.ipa in build repository Releases
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
tag="xsign-build-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
gh release create "$tag" packages/X-SIGN.ipa --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --target "$GITHUB_SHA" --title "XSign · Build $GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER ($GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT)" --notes-file packages/BUILD_MODE.txt
echo "[Download X-SIGN.ipa]($GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/download/$tag/X-SIGN.ipa)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Save personal IPA to an unpublished draft
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
tag="xsign-personal-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}"
release=$(gh api --method POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases" -f tag_name="$tag" -f target_commitish="$GITHUB_SHA" -f name="$tag" -F draft=true)
release_id=$(jq -er 'select(.draft == true) | .id | numbers' <<<"$release")
asset=$(gh api --method POST "https://uploads.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/$release_id/assets?name=X-SIGN.ipa" -H 'Content-Type: application/octet-stream' --input packages/X-SIGN.ipa)
bytes=$(wc -c < packages/X-SIGN.ipa)
jq -e --argjson bytes "$bytes" 'select(.state == "uploaded" and .name == "X-SIGN.ipa" and .size == $bytes)' <<<"$asset" >/dev/null
page=$(jq -er '.html_url' <<<"$release")
echo "release_id=$release_id" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "[Open your draft and download X-SIGN.ipa]($page)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Commit and push to the selected branch
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
git add -- Tools/XSign_Studio.html Tools/XSign_Studio_v2.html
git diff --cached --check
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
  echo 'XSign source already matches this update.' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
  exit 0
fi
if ! git diff --cached --quiet -- .github/workflows xsign-build.json; then
  echo '::error::Unexpected changes to workflows or the saved release request.'
  exit 1
fi
git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
git commit -m 'Apply XSign source and Studio update'
git push origin "HEAD:$GITHUB_REF"
printf 'XSign source and Studio committed to %s (%s).\n' "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" "$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
